goal: Launcher: app.launch, DataBoot.bat, Start-DataBoot.ps1 (Board gate 161 renames AC-13's Start-DataOS.ps1) and Dockerfile

acceptance_criteria.text: python -m app.launch <folder> [--port 8765] [--no-browser] exits 2 with one stderr line when the folder is missing, sets DATABOOT_DATA, takes the first free port from 8765 (20 tries), runs uvicorn on 127.0.0.1 and calls open_browser(url) once server.started; run(folder, port, open_browser) and launch.SERVER are exposed
tests/test_launch.py: with a fake open_browser the URL http://127.0.0.1:<port>/ is received, GET / returns 200, then SERVER.should_exit stops it (AC-11)

DataBoot.bat calls Start-DataBoot.ps1 with -ExecutionPolicy Bypass; Start-DataBoot.ps1 [-Folder] [-Docker] opens a FolderBrowserDialog when no folder is given, creates .venv with py -3.11 (fallback python), installs requirements.txt (--no-index --find-links wheels when a wheels folder exists) and runs the app.launch module for Windows 11 with a folder or drive letter

With -Docker the script checks `docker info` (message and exit 1 otherwise), builds the image if missing, runs `docker run --rm -d -p 8765:8765 -v "${Folder}:/data:ro"` and does Start-Process http://localhost:8765/; no file named Start-DataOS.ps1 exists (gate 161)
Dockerfile: FROM python:3.11-slim, installs requirements.txt, copies app/, ENV DATABOOT_DATA=/data, CMD uvicorn app.main:app on 0.0.0.0:8765; text checks in tests/test_launcher_files.py
Moves acceptance items AC-11, AC-13 forward

decisions.what: run() imports app.main after setting DATABOOT_DATA and starts a daemon thread that waits for server.started before calling open_browser; main passes None for --no-browser
decisions.why: Single open_browser call only after the server is up; works when run() is in a non-main thread (uvicorn skips signal handlers there)

decisions.what: Dockerfile uses WORKDIR /srv and copies app/ to /srv/app
decisions.why: Ticket asks only for requirements install, app/ copy, ENV and CMD; uvicorn app.main:app needs the package importable from the working directory

decisions.what: Test sets DATABOOT_DATA via monkeypatch.setenv before run()
decisions.why: run() writes os.environ; monkeypatch restores it so later tests are not affected

tried_and_failed.what: First attempt to write all files in one Bash heredoc command
tried_and_failed.why_it_failed: The ProdAgents pretool deny list blocked the command; used the Write tool instead
